focuses.desc:
Ataturk's Republic: secular, nationalist, poor, and sitting on the Straits between every great power of the coming war. Its whole policy - under Ataturk and, from 1938, Ismet Inonu, the 'Milli Sef' - is to stay out: to balance Britain against Germany and both against the Soviet Union, sell chromium to whoever pays, and fight no one.

THE TREE (WiF draft v2): the vanilla tree's spirit, rebuilt WIDE around that balancing act - with the vanilla MILITARY tree kept as it is (its 20 focuses keep their vanilla ids and rewards). No communist path (an Allied-victory scenario may add one later).

TWO ROADS from 'The Balancing Act':
1. THE HISTORICAL ROAD - Lean Towards the Allies: Adana, Hardihood, Cicero, Cairo, the chromium embargo, the break with Berlin, Molotov's demands, war on the Axis in February 1945 and the San Francisco Conference. It ENDS IN 1945 (to be expanded for Allied-victory scenarios). If Germany wins instead, 'Bow to the Victor' jumps across into the German-aligned tree's post-war half.
2. WAIT FOR THE VICTOR: armed neutrality, German transit, the generals' tour of the Eastern Front, chromium for the Reich - until Germany has beaten the Western Allies OR the Soviet Union. Then Turkey joins Germany, and the road runs to about 1950: Turan (Azerbaijan against Kaukasien's ambitions, Batum and Kars, the Crimean Tatars, Turkestan), Iraq cut off from beaten Britain (Mosul, Kirkuk, Rashid Ali, a protectorate in Baghdad), and - when the Reich falls apart and Rome invites Turkey into its Pact - influence in Bulgaria and Romania and a Turkish Black Sea.

SYRIA (Axis road): ask Vichy for northern Syria late in the tree; if it refuses, march in when the Reich falls apart - Syria (with Lebanon) is made independent and armed from Vichy's garrison and stockpile, and Turkey has 45 days of limited war to win it, or be humiliated.

KUWAIT (Axis road): a political minigame - Turkish Influence at the Sheikh's court against Unrest stoked against the cut-off British and Canadian garrison - to make Kuwait Turkish.

CHOICES ALONG THE WAY: Bayar or Saydam; the Istanbul Route or Closed Doors; the Kemalist State or the Turanist Movement; Mosul annexed or Iraq ruled through Rashid Ali; Montreux rewritten or Straits shared with Rome.

- TURKISH INFLUENCE (0-100): won at the Sheikh's court and among the pearl merchants.

Effect: Romania +50 opinion; Romanian influence +25%.
focuses.name: Influence in Bucharest

focuses.desc:
With the Soviet fleet gone and the Germans busy, the Black Sea is Turkey's lake.

Effect: +2 dockyards. +10% navy organisation.
focuses.name: Master of the Black Sea

focuses.desc:
Romanian oil, paid for in Turkish chromium and cotton.

Effect: +6 oil (trade). Romania +15 opinion.
focuses.name: Oil from Ploesti

focuses.desc:
From Thrace to the Danube, Ankara's word counts - under Rome's umbrella.

Available: Bulgaria or Romania is in our or Italy's faction.
Effect: Bulgaria and Romania join our sphere: +15% stability, +10% political power.
focuses.name: The Turkish Balkan Sphere

focuses.desc:
By 1950 Turkey is the strongest state between the Adriatic and Iran - still Kemalist, still careful, and on the winning side.

Effect: +15% stability, +10% factory output.
focuses.name: A Regional Power

focuses.desc:
Ataturk's Republic has outlived its founder and survived the war that broke Europe. What it becomes now is up to Ankara.

Effect: +10% political power, +10% stability.
focuses.name: The Republic at Twenty-Seven

focuses.desc:
Even though our armies emerged from the War of Liberation victorious against the Entente and the Ottomans, our nation paid the price for freedom in blood. We must never again allow a disaster of such a devastating scale to strike our country again. We must learn from our past mistakes, and study our victories.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Learning from the Great War

focuses.desc:
We have fallen behind the curve when it comes to technological innovations in warfare. To avoid a repeat of the bloodshed of our past, we must quickly modernize our tactics and our equipment.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Modernizing the Army

focuses.desc:
We are proud of having such an old and venerable academy dedicated to military and civilian aviation. We should put a greater focus on our air warfare efforts.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Hava Okulu

focuses.desc:
Our nation is very large, and it is vital that our air force be able to cover every inch of [ROOT.GetAdjective] territory.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Expand the Air Bases

focuses.desc:
It is an ambitious goal but one that is pursued out of necessity. Sooner or later, all armies will be mechanized. We must simply decide whether we prepared to undertake such an effort now, or wait until it becomes more viable in the future.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Mechanizing Our Army

focuses.desc:
The Ottoman Empire used to menace the entire continent of Europe. Sure, some mistakes were made - but by looking to the past perhaps we might once again have an army capable of marching all the way to the gates of Vienna and beyond.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Embrace Military Tradition

focuses.desc:
We have become too reliant upon the foreign designs of armored vehicles. We shall design our very own [ROOT.GetAdjective] tank - the Kırıkkale Tank!

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: The Kırıkkale Tank

focuses.desc:
Why throw men at a problem when bullets and shells are far more expendable? We must make a greater effort to save the lives of our soldiers through the use of overwhelming firepower.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Superiority of Arms

focuses.desc:
Anatolia is a defender's dream and an invader's worst nightmare. We know our country, and we should train to utilize the natural defenses of our nation to make any invasion a hard-fought battle.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Utilizing Our Terrain

focuses.desc:
Field Marshal Fevzi Çakmak has proposed building a defensive line of fortifications around Edirne and the Bosporus Straits. While there has been some trepidation among officials about pursuing the project, ultimately the benefits outweigh the costs and it is about time we got started on the fortline.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Construct the Çakmak Line

focuses.desc:
Our aviation industry is old and well-respected, but few distinctly [ROOT.GetAdjective] plane designs have met the standards for production. We must work to change that.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Accelerate Native Fighter Designs

focuses.desc:
Our ocean is our natural barrier against invasion and we must care for it just as we would a land border.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Patrol the Seas

focuses.desc:
We learned from Mehmed II that when a problem seems insurmountable, a big cannon will usually prove to be a very viable solution.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Invoke the Methods of Mehmed II

focuses.desc:
We must work to defend our air space in the case of an aerial attack from the seas or from one of our neighbors' territories.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Turkish Air Defense Platforms

focuses.desc:
By expanding the Gölcük Naval Base we will be able to support our strategic goals in the strait and Aegean sea.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Expand the Gölcük Naval Base

focuses.desc:
We have centered our naval efforts around Çanakkale and the Straits for far too long. It is time to finally act on our plans to expand the Port of Mersin.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Relocate from Yıldız Palace

focuses.desc:
The Ottoman Fleet was truly impressive, and if there is at least one thing worthy of mourning from the fallen empire it would be the illustrious navy it wielded. We can honor that legacy with a more modern navy today.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: The Legacy of the Osmanlı Donanması

focuses.desc:
Like the wolf, we must always be on the prowl. We shall stay low, and attack when our enemy least expects it. We have the mindset of wolves, and the submarine is the perfect tool to exercise that mindset.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: The Path of the Wolf

focuses.desc:
It is said the best offence is a good defense, and our official stance is that we do not disagree!

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Fortified Defensive Bases

focuses.desc:
Our armed forces have become truly modern and are no longer the shade they had become after the terrible War of Independence. We could take on the world in our current state. We should be proud of how far we have come.

(Vanilla focus, kept unchanged.)
focuses.name: Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri
